name: Ankou
summary: Watchers of concealed horrors who distance themselves from ordinary human life while guarding against threats few Kindred perceive.
baneSummary: Whenever an Ankou would regain Willpower by maintaining the Mask, roll Humanity. On a failure, no Willpower is regained.

name: Icelus
summary: Methodical auditors of Kindred society whose hypnotic detachment makes failures of conscience dangerously exploitable.
baneSummary: In addition to the parent Clan bane, a failed detachment roll that inflicts Bestial, Competitive, or Wanton also inflicts Mesmerized. Resolving it does not grant the usual +3 resistance to Dominate.

name: Jharana
summary: Vampires attuned to transmissions and omens of the God-Machine who can inspect and reconfigure living signals.
baneSummary: When a Jharana feeds from the same person more than once in a chapter, roll Humanity. Failure inflicts a Persistent Obsession tied to that person and the signals surrounding them.

name: Lidérc
summary: Emotional predators who cultivate intense circles of lovers and dependents, feeding on devotion as much as blood.
baneSummary: While Dependent, all attached Touchstones provide only +1 die total to detachment. Defending the subject restores at most 1 Willpower, and a subject who was a Touchstone is lost immediately when the relationship breaks.

name: Nosoi
summary: Plague-bearing Gangrel whose Blood adapts to a chosen illness and punishes feeding that avoids it.
baneSummary: Choose a blood-carried ailment. Each night, Vitae gained from blood not infected with that ailment cannot raise the Nosoi's Vitae above her Humanity.

name: The Parliamentarians
summary: Carthian architects of rigid personal systems who seek security and leverage through a meticulously ordered Requiem.
baneSummary: When the Parliamentarian's personal order is disrupted, Humanity dots cap all Social dice pools.

name: Penumbrae
summary: Crone seers who read truth through torpor and dreams, trading reliable memory for occult revelation.
baneSummary: Determine torpor duration using Humanity minus Crúac dots. Waking early costs additional Vitae equal to Crúac, and waking from torpor or Clotho's Skein inflicts False Memories until the next daysleep.

name: Scions of the First City
summary: Invictus urbanists who claim descent from the first great city and draw strength from dense metropolitan life.
baneSummary: Outside a metropolis, or in a settlement with fewer than 10,000 people, Humanity dots cap every dice pool.

name: Vardyvle
summary: Covetous identity thieves who stalk lives they envy and reshape themselves around stolen memories.
baneSummary: When feeding from a human she envies, roll Humanity. Failure grants one of the victim's memories and False Memory for a week; dramatic failure also inflicts addiction to the victim's blood.

name: Vilseduire
summary: Tempters who strip away restraint and encourage excess while their own connection to Humanity erodes.
baneSummary: A Vilseduire can have no more than one attached Touchstone and treats all breaking points as though at half normal Humanity, rounded down.

name: Morbus
summary: Outcast plague angels who cultivate disease and wield it as a weapon from the shadows.
baneSummary: In addition to the Mekhet bane, the Morbus can feed on living mortals only when they are diseased; Kindred Vitae remains nourishing.

name: Bron
summary: Knights errant and bravos who bind themselves to blood, quest, and oath.
baneSummary: In addition to the Ventrue bane, a change in permanent Blood Potency detaches every Touchstone; each night an unattached Touchstone may be replaced after a failed Humanity roll.

name: Khaibit
summary: Ancient soldiers who fight the darkness by embracing and mastering it.
baneSummary: Bright light that would inhibit ordinary vision inflicts the Blinded Tilt and suppresses Udjat for the scene.
source: Onyx Path Blog: The Shadow and the Asp

name: Kerberos
summary: Self-reinventing social predators who excel at projecting the Beast through its three aspects.
baneSummary: Against anyone not subject to a Predatory Aura Condition, lose 10-again on all non-reflexive actions; Predatory Aura rolls are unaffected.
source: Onyx Path Blog: The Jaws of the Beast

name: Children of Judas
summary: Grief-addicted Daeva who taste a victim's worst remorse and weaponize buried guilt.
baneSummary: After more than Humanity nights without feeding from someone experiencing grief, remorse, or regret, roll Resolve + Composure on rising with a cumulative penalty for each overdue night. Failure inflicts Deprived until the vampire feeds from an appropriately sorrowful vessel.
giftSummary: The first time the vampire feeds from a vessel, she receives an involuntary vision of a tragic event from that person's past.

name: Duchagne
summary: Jaded sensualists who need extreme sensation to make feeding feel alive.
baneSummary: Unless feeding involves intense physical sensation such as pain, pleasure, or extreme temperature, spend Willpower or apply the Daeva clan bane even on the first feeding from that vessel.
giftSummary: Once per night, feeding from a victim experiencing extreme sensation can refresh one spent Willpower; causing additional harm imposes -1 on the resulting detachment roll.

name: Erzsébet
summary: Near-living Daeva whose bodies age as Humanity wanes.
baneSummary: At Humanity 6 or lower the vampire ages at one quarter the human rate. Once per chapter after a breaking point, failure on a Humanity roll ages her one year during daysleep; equal time in torpor reverses this only as far as her Embrace age.
giftSummary: Hair and nails grow at will, physical changes persist through daysleep without Willpower, and a permanent blush of life can be intensified with Vitae for mortal healing, masked aura, and exceptional Empathy.

name: Gulikan
summary: Hyperosmic perfumers who distill stolen scents into occult recipes.
baneSummary: After more than passing intimate contact with a living person, roll Humanity. Failure causes an Obsession focused on that person's scent until the vampire immerses herself in it; a new instance replaces the old one.

name: Moda Mortale
summary: Perfectionist assassins who turn fashion and murder into precise messages.
baneSummary: When a setback or flaw disrupts the vampire's current plan, roll Humanity. Failure inflicts Broken until it resolves or the task is complete; the bane cannot trigger again while Broken remains.
giftSummary: Bloodline Status grants Friends Abroad alongside Cacophony Savvy, a qualifying Fighting Style dot, and Taste or a one-Experience refund if Taste is already owned.

name: Nelapsi
summary: Legend-haunted predators whose insatiable feeding sustains their terrifying reputations.
baneSummary: After feeding, roll Humanity. Failure makes the vampire count as starving for frenzy until she drinks Blood Potency Vitae; Willpower suppresses this for one scene, and excess blood is vomited.
giftSummary: Nelapsi mentorship is expressed through Quickened Hunger and Shadow Heart, Fame (Advanced), and the Cursed Fiefdom Devotion rather than an automatic power.

name: Star-Crossed
summary: Custodians who preserve mortal Purities in repeating moments and refine their timeless blood into Electrum.
baneSummary: After a mortal sees any visual representation of the vampire, the Star-Crossed's Social actions with that mortal are capped by Humanity for the rest of the night. Touchstones are exempt, but Purities are not.
giftSummary: Anoint a mortal with Vitae and Willpower to lock the subject into a renewable 24-hour biological loop that reverses aging, disease, injury, and death while imposing persistent confusion.

name: Xiao
summary: Emotionally blunted predators divided between the exploitative Sect and Apostates who weaponize their detachment.
baneSummary: Mundane Empathy and Socialize rolls involving humans treat Humanity as two dots lower, and failures become dramatic failures. This does not apply to Touchstones.

name: Baetyl
summary: Stone-eating Gangrel who incorporate swallowed material into their mutable flesh.
baneSummary: In addition to the Feral Curse, the vampire also suffers the Nosferatu clan bane as inorganic material progressively deforms her body.
giftSummary: The vampire can swallow inanimate matter and once per scene spend Vitae to add the consumed material's Size, maximum +5, to Auspex rolls for the scene.

name: Cerrid
summary: Nomadic performers whose songs soothe and direct the Beast.
baneSummary: At least once every 11 minus Blood Potency nights, regain Willpower from the Mask through performance. Otherwise a visible mutation lowers effective Humanity by two for the Feral Curse until all Willpower is regained through performance or torpor intervenes.
giftSummary: Gain one Expression dot on joining, or another Social Skill if Expression is already maximum; spending Willpower on mundane Expression grants +5 instead of +3.

name: Childer of the Morrigan
summary: Warrior Acolytes who invoke Crúac in sudden, violent bursts.
baneSummary: Backing down, de-escalating, or resolving an important problem without direct conflict causes a cumulative -1 to frenzy resistance for the rest of the night.
giftSummary: Spend Willpower to cast a rite of three dots or less instantly with reduced successes and Potency; failure becomes dramatic and temporarily curses everyone nearby. Beast's Skin always includes a crow or raven form.

name: Daimonion
summary: Counselors who read and manipulate the instincts of other Beasts.
baneSummary: While Tempted, witnessing another vampire enter involuntary frenzy requires spending Willpower or resisting a sympathetic frenzy whose impulse is to assist that vampire; resisting once grants immunity for the scene.
giftSummary: Auspex gains an extra question about a vampire's Beast and intimate-contact benefits against frenzy, Bestial Triad Conditions, and draugr.

name: Dead Wolves
summary: Moon-bound Gangrel who borrow the forms and mysteries of werewolves.
baneSummary: Seeing the full moon for the first time each night provokes frenzy; Sublunario can shift the triggering phase. The first silver-weapon injury each scene provokes fear frenzy at -3.

name: Mystikoi
summary: Mystic predators who seek divinity by consuming supernatural essence.
baneSummary: Each night only Humanity Vitae from humans provides nourishment unless Willpower is spent per excess feeding. Kindred blood is exempt below Blood Potency 6, as is werewolf blood.
giftSummary: An exclusive five-dot Discipline that refines consumed supernatural essence into a path of bodily and spiritual transcendence.

name: Oberlochs
summary: A sprawling rural family whose corpses continue to age and breed the line true.
baneSummary: The vampire ages and takes Humanity-based Social penalties when relating to other vampires as though they were mortals; Humanity 9-10 grants no bonus. Her childer enter the bloodline automatically.

name: Verlice
summary: Restless nomads mystically bonded to a chosen vehicle.
baneSummary: Each night after the first spent sleeping within the same Blood Potency-mile radius lowers effective Humanity by one for attached Touchstones. Resting a full day somewhere new relieves it, and the old area cannot be reused for a week.
giftSummary: Anoint a vehicle with Vitae and spend Willpower to make it the vampire's bonded Ride, enabling the bloodline's vehicle Devotions.

name: Wickers
summary: Avian augurs who draw terrible omens from pain and disaster.
baneSummary: After a failed breaking point, roll Humanity. Failure attracts a Strix before the story ends; successes impose cumulative -1 on later rolls until the bane triggers. This entry records the printed bane but does not implement Strix mechanics.

name: Yarilo
summary: Plantlike Gangrel rooted to sacred Heartwood trees and clouds of controlling spores.
baneSummary: After taking fire damage, treat Humanity as one lower for attaching Touchstones for the rest of the night.

name: Connected
summary: Networked Mekhet who treat digital systems as extensions of their senses.
baneSummary: Among more than 10 minus Blood Potency mortals in a genuinely social or crowded setting, roll Humanity. Failure inflicts Distracted until the vampire escapes the crowd or the scene ends; digital gatherings and Touchstones are exempt.
giftSummary: An exclusive five-dot Discipline for sensing, entering, protecting, and controlling digital systems.

name: Család
summary: Territorial Mekhet who read and command the living history of cities and land.
baneSummary: On nights after resting outside her territory, suffering any breaking point also inflicts Lethargic. Territory may be represented by Feeding Grounds, Haven, Safe Place, or a narrative domain.
giftSummary: A ritual Discipline whose rites bind the vampire to territory and reveal or direct the memories and forces of the land.

name: Kuufukuji
summary: Ascetic Mekhet who pursue insight through hunger and controlled deprivation.
baneSummary: Drinking more Vitae than Humanity in one night inflicts Bestial until the vampire abstains for a full night; frenzy failures during that time become hunger frenzy. References to revenant creation are intentionally not implemented.

name: Leandros
summary: Predators who form consuming romantic fixations through feeding.
baneSummary: After feeding from a mortal, roll Resolve + Composure. Failure makes that mortal the only satisfying vessel, capping nourishment from all other sources at half Humanity until the mortal dies or the vampire next succeeds at a breaking point. Invitation is mandatory if the clan bane has not manifested.

name: Mnemosyne
summary: Memory thieves who preserve history by drinking it from blood.
baneSummary: When feeding again from a previous vessel, roll Humanity. Failure inflicts False Memories drawn from that victim; later failures alter the same single instance.

name: Norvegi
summary: Inbred outlaws whose Beasts visibly warp their flesh.
baneSummary: Unless Willpower is spent or a Humanity roll succeeds, Social actions for the scene suffer half Blood Potency, rounded up. The penalty does not apply to other Norvegi or their named kin. Fangless is mandatory if the clan bane has not manifested.

name: Qedeshah
summary: Protective Mekhet who anoint mortals as extensions of their Touchstones.
baneSummary: After more than Humanity nights without defending a Touchstone or anointed mortal, gain Guilty. It resolves only by defending an attachment strongly enough to recover all Willpower; with no attachments, it becomes Persistent until one is gained.
giftSummary: The bloodline can consecrate selected mortals as anointed attachments used by its protective Merits and Devotions.

name: Acteius
summary: Methodical blood-artisans who craft tools and weapons from Vitae.
baneSummary: When an unexpected setback or unlikely turn occurs, roll Humanity. Failure inflicts Tempted as the Beast reacts to disruption.

name: Candymen
summary: Alchemical drug dealers whose blood-laced concoctions reshape appetite.
baneSummary: Choose a defining vessel type. On rising, roll Humanity; failure makes all other vessels non-nourishing for the night, including stored blood, unless they consumed the vampire's concoctions.
giftSummary: The vampire can infuse drugs and treats with Vitae, making consumers valid vessels and enabling the bloodline's addictive Devotions.

name: The Cockscomb Society
summary: Decadent aristocrats whose cultivated civility barely restrains monstrous urges.
baneSummary: Apply the Nosferatu Social penalty with mortals to rolls resisting Bestial, Competitive, Wanton, and similar urges; use the higher modifier if effects overlap, and failures become dramatic failures.
giftSummary: The Society's inherited wealth and connections provide lineage-specific social leverage and support its role-playing Devotions.

name: Gethsemani
summary: Stigmatic prophets who turn holy terror into blood miracles.
baneSummary: On rising, spend extra Vitae equal to half Blood Potency, rounded up, or manifest stigmatic wounds that lower effective Humanity by one for the Nosferatu clan bane until daysleep.
giftSummary: The bloodline's supernatural stigmata enable its signature Theban Miracles and devotional feeding practices.

name: Keepers of the Dark
summary: Subterranean wardens who shape labyrinthine havens and hoard secrets in darkness.
baneSummary: Bright light such as a flashlight, bonfire, or full moon inflicts Distracted for the scene unless a Humanity roll succeeds.

name: Lygos
summary: Mystics of absolute darkness who learn the progressive Truths of Erebus.
baneSummary: Outside dim light, Humanity counts as one lower for the Nosferatu bane and frenzy resistance suffers -1.
giftSummary: The bloodline treats the five Truths as a primary Mystery and may learn Lessons of Erebus as its associated procedures.

name: Von Schreck Family
summary: Horror-industry predators who need a live audience for their feeding performances.
baneSummary: Unless mortals observe the feeding live, directly or remotely, spend Willpower or cap each vessel's Vitae capacity at half Humanity, rounded down. Frenzy and Kindred blood are exempt.
giftSummary: The bloodline exploits live spectators and horror fandom to amplify fear, feeding, and its cinematic Devotions.

name: Yagnatia
summary: Feudal blood-sorcerers who bargain with the gods and spirits of their land.
baneSummary: Humanity caps dice pools and traits used to resist the Numina of ephemeral beings. References to Strix powers are recorded by the source but not implemented.

name: Adrestoi
summary: Pack-bound Lords who submit their Beasts to a chosen master through Blood Tether.
baneSummary: The vampire has Blood of the Unwilling, but requires feeding permission from a superior with equal or higher relevant Kindred Status; a pack master has final authority. Once granted, permission normally cannot be rescinded.
giftSummary: A five-dot Discipline that binds a pack to its master and distributes senses, emotion, strength, and feeding across the tether.

name: Gottlings
summary: Supernatural directors who turn people into performers in their obsessive productions.
baneSummary: Without an attached Touchstone, gain Obsession toward the current project until it is completed, Humanity rises, or a new Touchstone is acquired.

name: Keravnos
summary: Electrical Ventrue who feed from current and command power grids.
baneSummary: A breaking point for harming mortals with electricity moves Touchstones one Humanity level higher. If the vampire fed only from electricity that night, detachment rolls suffer -2.
giftSummary: An exclusive five-dot Discipline that consumes, stores, senses, and redirects electricity.

name: Malocusians
summary: Reclusive domain masters whose homes become extensions of their bodies and will.
baneSummary: Leaving home without spending Willpower allows Humanity minus Blood Potency hours away, minimum one, before frenzy resistance takes cumulative -1 per hour to -5 until a full day is spent at home.
giftSummary: The vampire mystically extends senses and authority through her domicile, empowering its defenses and the bloodline's household Devotions.

name: Melissidae
summary: Hive-building Ventrue who absorb insects and people into a collective organism.
baneSummary: Every Touchstone must belong to the hive, and at least one attached Touchstone is required for any to count as attached. Inanimate places and objects cannot serve as Touchstones.
giftSummary: The vampire can communicate with and command insects, laying the foundation for Hivemind and the bloodline's colony Devotions.

name: Rotgrafen
summary: Pirate Lords whose Beasts reject obedience without an equitable price.
baneSummary: Submitting to authority without fair compensation caps frenzy-resistance rolls by Humanity for the night, including retroactively if the bargain is broken. Trivial demands, self-preservation, and other Rotgrafen are exempt.

name: Typhos
summary: Biomedical predators who alter mortal hosts through Arthmoic Surgery and the international Typhos Institute.
baneSummary: Treat Humanity as one dot lower on rolls to relate to humans. The penalty is permanently removed for a human on whom the Typhos performs a substantial medical procedure.

name: Warumono
summary: Tattooed gangsters who channel control through disciplined paths and spectacular violence.
baneSummary: After violent action or drawing blood, including feeding, the Lost Visage fails for the scene and mundane subtlety, Stealth, and escape-notice rolls are capped by Humanity.

name: Malkovians
summary: Afflicted seers who perceive impossible truths through Malkavia and Dementation.
baneSummary: Each chapter the Storyteller gains 10 minus Humanity dice to oppose successful Social attempts to communicate truths. If successes are reduced to failure, it becomes dramatic and that truth cannot be communicated again until the next night; Touchstones are exempt.
giftSummary: The vampire reads meaningful patterns in apparent coincidence, gaining prophetic insight while risking the Pareidolia Condition.
